name: sidebar
summary: Arranges a stable supporting rail beside a flexible main region.

agent.useWhen: A supporting rail belongs beside a flexible main region at a chosen container width.
agent.avoidWhen: The regions need equal or arbitrary proportions; use Split instead.

invariants: Main and aside are required neutral regions, not landmarks.
Region DOM order matches visual order for keyboard reading.
The rail collapses until its configured container-query boundary.
